info.title: humanOS API
info.description: Backend API for humanOS: nutrition, workouts, health metrics, goals and recommendations.

post.description:
Creates the account, sends the email verification link and issues the first
personal access token. The token is named after `device_name`, or the User-Agent
when it is missing.

Checks the credentials and issues a new personal access token. Wrong credentials
return a validation error on `email`. Limited to 5 attempts per minute per email and IP.

Emails a password reset link. The response is the same whether the email is
registered or not, so it cannot be used to discover accounts.

message.const: If that email is registered, a password reset link has been sent.

post.description:
Sets a new password using the token from the reset email, and revokes every
personal access token of the user.

get.description:
Marks the email as verified. This is the link sent by email: it is authenticated by
its signature (`expires` and `signature` query parameters), not by a token. Verifying
an already verified email succeeds.

post.description: Revokes the token used for this request. Other tokens of the user stay valid.

get.description: Returns the user the bearer token belongs to.

post.description:
Sends a new verification link to the current user. Returns 202 when the email is
sent, and 200 when the email is already verified.

get.description: Lists the user's personal access tokens, newest first. Token values are never returned.

delete.description: Deletes every token of the user, including the one used for this request.

Deletes one of the user's tokens. A token that does not exist or belongs to another
user returns 404.

get.description:
Returns the user's body profile with their latest weight and target weight. Values are
returned in the user's `unit_system` and in metric. A user who has not saved a profile
yet gets 404.

put.description:
Creates the user's profile or fully replaces it; every field is required. Values are read
in `unit_system` units, stored in metric, and `unit_system` is kept as the display
preference. Each save also records one weight entry and one target weight entry, even when
the values did not change. Always returns 200.

get.description:
Lists every weight the user has recorded, newest first. One entry is added on each profile
save. `weight` is in the profile's `unit_system` (metric if the user has no profile yet).

Lists every target weight the user has set, newest first. One entry is added on each profile
save. `target_weight` is in the profile's `unit_system` (metric if the user has no profile yet).

height.description: Height in `unit_system` units: centimetres (metric) or inches (imperial).

weight.description: Latest weight in `unit_system` units: kilograms (metric) or pounds (imperial).

target_weight.description: Latest target weight in `unit_system` units: kilograms (metric) or pounds (imperial).

Target weight in the profile's `unit_system`: kilograms (metric, also used when the user
has no profile) or pounds (imperial).

unit_system.description:
Units of `height`, `weight` and `target_weight`: cm/kg (metric) or inches/lb
(imperial). Also saved as the user's display preference.

birth_date.description: The user must be 13 to 120 years old today.

height.description: Height in centimetres (50–272) or total inches (19.7–107.1).

weight.description: Current weight in kilograms (20–500) or pounds (44.1–1102.3), at most 1 decimal.

target_weight.description: Target weight in kilograms (20–500) or pounds (44.1–1102.3), at most 1 decimal.

weight.description:
Weight in the profile's `unit_system`: kilograms (metric, also used when the user
has no profile) or pounds (imperial).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
